response.sql: WITH observatory_shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 100.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as share_pct FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(share_pct) as avg_share FROM observatory_shares) SELECT AVG(os.telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(os.share_pct) as avg_share, AVG(os.share_pct) - (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg) as avg_above_average FROM observatory_shares os WHERE os.share_pct > (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg)

assumptions.assumption: Share of telescopes is expressed as a percentage (0–100 scale: count per observatory / total count × 100) rather than as a decimal fraction (0–1 scale)

alternatives.interpretation: Share is a decimal fraction (0–1) instead of a percentage
alternatives.sql: WITH observatory_shares AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) as telescope_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM telescopes) as share_frac FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(share_frac) as avg_share FROM observatory_shares) SELECT AVG(os.telescope_count) as avg_telescope_count, AVG(os.share_frac) as avg_share, AVG(os.share_frac) - (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg) as avg_above_average FROM observatory_shares os WHERE os.share_frac > (SELECT avg_share FROM overall_avg)
